title: Painted Face in Abyss
description: A close-up portrait of a person's face and upper neck, eyes closed, with their skin transformed into a swirling, melting composition of vibrant blue, red, green, and gold paint. Organic coral-like and fluid forms emerge from the mouth and neck area against a dark abstract background filled with smoky clouds and floating particles.
prompt: close-up surreal portrait of a person's face with eyes closed, skin melting and transforming into swirling vibrant blue, red, magenta and lime green paint with gold accents, organic coral and fluid forms growing from the mouth and neck, dramatic dark background with smoky clouds and floating particles, highly detailed textures, painterly style
